```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(openxlsx)

data <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/公路客運2024_to_202606.csv",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)


routes_hualien_THB <- c(
  "1121",
  "1122",
  "1123",
  "1125",
  "1126",
  "1128",
  "1129",
  "1130",
  "1132",
  "1133",
  "1135",
  "1136",
  "1137",
  "1139",
  "1140",
  "1141",
  "1142",
  "1143",
  "1145",
  "8119",
  "8161",
  "8173",
  "8181"
)



data$`資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)` <- as.Date(
  data$`資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)`,
  format = "%Y-%m-%d"
)


data$搭乘路線代碼 <- trimws(
  as.character(data$搭乘路線代碼)
)

data$搭乘附屬路線代碼 <- trimws(
  as.character(data$搭乘附屬路線代碼)
)

data$搭乘附屬路線名稱 <- trimws(
  as.character(data$搭乘附屬路線名稱)
)


match_main_code <- intersect(
  routes_hualien_THB,
  unique(data$搭乘路線代碼)
)

match_sub_code <- intersect(
  routes_hualien_THB,
  unique(data$搭乘附屬路線代碼)
)

match_sub_name <- intersect(
  routes_hualien_THB,
  unique(data$搭乘附屬路線名稱)
)



if (length(match_sub_code) > 0) {

  route_field <- "搭乘附屬路線代碼"

} else if (length(match_main_code) > 0) {

  route_field <- "搭乘路線代碼"

} else if (length(match_sub_name) > 0) {

  route_field <- "搭乘附屬路線名稱"

} else {

  stop(
    "找不到指定的花蓮公路客運路線"
  )
}



data <- data %>%
  filter(
    `資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)` >= as.Date("2024-06-01"),
    `資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)` <= as.Date("2026-06-30"),

    `票種次類型` %in% c(
      "#HUA-199",
      "#HUA-399"
    ),

    !is.na(卡號),
    trimws(as.character(卡號)) != ""
  )



if (route_field == "搭乘附屬路線代碼") {

  data <- data %>%
    filter(
      搭乘附屬路線代碼 %in%
        routes_hualien_THB
    )
}


if (route_field == "搭乘路線代碼") {

  data <- data %>%
    filter(
      搭乘路線代碼 %in%
        routes_hualien_THB
    )
}


if (route_field == "搭乘附屬路線名稱") {

  data <- data %>%
    filter(
      搭乘附屬路線名稱 %in%
        routes_hualien_THB
    )
}



if (nrow(data) == 0) {

  stop(
    "篩選後沒有資料，請檢查TPASS票種或路線代碼"
  )
}


data <- data %>%
  mutate(

    Year = year(
      `資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)`
    ),

    Month = month(
      `資料代表日期(yyyy-MM-dd)`
    ),

    月份 = sprintf(
      "%03d%02d",
      Year - 1911,
      Month
    )
  )



person_monthly <- data %>%
  count(
    Year,
    Month,
    月份,
    卡號,
    name = "月搭乘次數"
  )


person_monthly <- person_monthly %>%
  mutate(

    搭乘次數區間 = case_when(

      月搭乘次數 == 1 ~
        "僅一次",

      月搭乘次數 >= 2 &
        月搭乘次數 <= 4 ~
        "二至四次",

      月搭乘次數 >= 5 ~
        "五次以上"
    )
  )



monthly_group <- person_monthly %>%
  count(
    Year,
    Month,
    月份,
    搭乘次數區間,
    name = "人數"
  )

month_table <- tibble(

  日期 = seq(
    as.Date("2024-06-01"),
    as.Date("2026-06-01"),
    by = "month"
  )

) %>%
  mutate(

    Year = year(日期),

    Month = month(日期),

    月份 = sprintf(
      "%03d%02d",
      Year - 1911,
      Month
    )
  )


full_group <- month_table %>%
  select(
    Year,
    Month,
    月份
  ) %>%

  crossing(

    搭乘次數區間 = c(
      "僅一次",
      "二至四次",
      "五次以上"
    )
  )


plot_data <- full_group %>%

  left_join(
    monthly_group,

    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Month",
      "月份",
      "搭乘次數區間"
    )
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    人數 = replace_na(
      人數,
      0
    )
  ) %>%

  select(
    月份,
    搭乘次數區間,
    人數
  ) %>%

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = 搭乘次數區間,
    values_from = 人數,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    match(
      月份,
      month_table$月份
    )
  )


table_result <- plot_data %>%

  mutate(

    總人數 =
      僅一次 +
      二至四次 +
      五次以上,

    僅一次百分比 =
      ifelse(
        總人數 == 0,
        "0.0%",
        sprintf(
          "%.1f%%",
          僅一次 / 總人數 * 100
        )
      ),

    二至四次百分比 =
      ifelse(
        總人數 == 0,
        "0.0%",
        sprintf(
          "%.1f%%",
          二至四次 / 總人數 * 100
        )
      ),

    五次以上百分比 =
      ifelse(
        總人數 == 0,
        "0.0%",
        sprintf(
          "%.1f%%",
          五次以上 / 總人數 * 100
        )
      )
  )


print(
  table_result
)

write.xlsx(

  table_result,

  "C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/113年6月至115年6月花蓮縣公路客運TPASS乘客各搭乘次數區間月人數統計表.xlsx",

  rowNames = FALSE
)


month_label <- plot_data$月份

once <- plot_data$僅一次

two_four <- plot_data$二至四次

five_more <- plot_data$五次以上


all_y <- c(
  once,
  two_four,
  five_more
)


y_breaks <- pretty(

  c(
    0,
    max(
      all_y,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ),

  n = 7
)


y_breaks <- y_breaks[
  y_breaks >= 0
]


once_y <- once

two_four_y <- two_four

five_more_y <- five_more


y_breaks_pos <- y_breaks



if (length(y_breaks) >= 2) {

  gap <-
    y_breaks[2] -
    y_breaks[1]

} else {

  gap <- 100
}


y_plot_min <-
  min(y_breaks) -
  gap / 2


y_plot_max <-
  max(y_breaks) +
  gap / 2



png(

  filename =
    "C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/113年6月至115年6月花蓮縣公路客運TPASS乘客各搭乘次數區間月人數變化折線圖.png",

  width = 12,

  height = 6,

  units = "in",

  res = 300
)


windowsFonts(

  kai =
    windowsFont(
      "Microsoft JhengHei"
    )
)


par(

  family = "kai",

  # 下、左、上、右
  mar = c(
    6,
    8,
    5,
    8
  )
)


plot(

  x =
    1:length(
      month_label
    ),

  y =
    once_y,

  type = "n",

  xaxt = "n",

  yaxt = "n",

  bty = "n",

  xlab = "",

  ylab = "",


  xlim = c(
    0.5,
    length(month_label) + 0.5
  ),


  ylim = c(
    y_plot_min,
    y_plot_max
  ),

  xaxs = "i",

  yaxs = "i"
)


abline(

  v =
    1:length(
      month_label
    ),

  col = "gray85",

  lty = 1,

  lwd = 1
)


abline(

  h =
    y_breaks_pos[
      y_breaks != 0
    ],

  col = "gray85",

  lty = 1,

  lwd = 1
)


lines(

  1:length(
    month_label
  ),

  once_y,

  type = "o",

  pch = 16,

  lwd = 2,

  col = "black"
)


lines(

  1:length(
    month_label
  ),

  two_four_y,

  type = "o",

  pch = 16,

  lwd = 2,

  col = "gray40"
)


lines(

  1:length(
    month_label
  ),

  five_more_y,

  type = "o",

  pch = 16,

  lwd = 2,

  col = "gray70"
)

mtext(

  "113年6月至115年6月花蓮縣公路客運TPASS乘客各搭乘次數區間月人數變化折線圖",

  side = 3,

  line = 1,

  at = 0.5,

  adj = 0,

  cex = 1.2,

  font = 2
)


mtext(

  "月份",

  side = 1,

  line = 3,

  cex = 1.1
)


mtext(

  "人數",

  side = 2,

  line = 4,

  cex = 1.1
)

x_index <- seq(

  1,

  length(
    month_label
  ),

  by = 2
)


axis(

  side = 1,

  at = x_index,

  labels =
    month_label[
      x_index
    ],

  las = 1,

  lwd = 0,

  lwd.ticks = 0,

  cex.axis = 1
)


axis(

  side = 2,

  at =
    y_breaks_pos[
      y_breaks != 0
    ],

  labels =
    format(

      y_breaks[
        y_breaks != 0
      ],

      big.mark = ",",

      scientific = FALSE
    ),

  las = 1,

  lwd = 0,

  lwd.ticks = 0,

  cex.axis = 1.1
)

legend(

  x =
    length(
      month_label
    ) * 1.02,

  y =
    max(
      all_y,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  title =
    "搭乘次數",

  legend = c(
    "僅一次",
    "二至四次",
    "五次以上"
  ),

  col = c(
    "black",
    "gray40",
    "gray70"
  ),

  lwd = 2,

  pch = 16,

  bty = "n",

  xpd = NA
)



dev.off()
```
